name: crew-companion
description: A desktop companion for Kiro Crew that helps you pace your day: it nudges you to take breaks, holds the reminders you set in plain language, and runs a short breathing exercise when you need to reset. It also lets you know when a session finishes, fails, or needs your OK.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Gentle break nudges — water, stretch, look away — on an interval you choose
Reminders you set in plain language, like “drink water in 20 minutes”
A short breathing exercise to reset when you need it
Tells you when a session finishes, fails, or needs your OK
Floats on your desktop with a swappable avatar
